# Efficiency floor (generated by `tools/measure_floor.py --render`; do not edit by hand)

Budget: 100 us per row at 200 Hz (20 ms per IMU-second), peak RAM 8 MB.
Design target: 50 us per row, 4 MB tracemalloc peak.

Peak RSS: Windows = PeakWorkingSetSize, private = PeakPagefileUsage (GetProcessMemoryInfo); Linux = GNU time %M (wait4 on a child of the Python harness is wrong: Linux seeds the child's maxrss with the parent's at exec). CPU time comes in clock ticks (Windows 15.6 ms, GNU time 10 ms), so CPU for processes shorter than ~50 ms is quantised; trust wall time there. Timing varies about +-15% between reruns on this laptop.
